scope: Native macOS Google Sheets clipboard behavior validation
method: Keyboard copy/cut/paste through native Dosty and Chrome UI using synthetic scratch data. Source assertions inspect saved Markdown artifacts.

cases.case: Dosty to default-formatted Google Sheets to Dosty
cases.assertion: All 20 visible values match the golden input, including final blank row.

cases.case: Adjacent quote fragments from native Sheets cells
cases.assertion: Two cells remain distinct despite ambiguous plain-text representation.
Literal data-dosty text does not change producer detection or quoted neighboring values.
Native checks confirmed correct destination clearing and one-/two-cell footprints.

cases.case: Fast Copy, Right, Paste with different old clipboard contents
cases.assertion: Adjacent cell receives newly copied plain value; one Undo restores golden source.
All 20 cells copied; Cut clears values while preserving structure and surrounding source.
One Undo restores HtmlRoundtrip.md byte-for-byte to html-roundtrip.md, including unterminated EOF.
Both axes grow from 2x2; pasted range selected; native Undo/Redo restores source and grid selection.

cases.case: Paste into pending cell draft then Escape
cases.assertion: Clipboard text stays in the local draft; cancellation leaves source unchanged.

cases.reason: Microsoft sign-in required; user requested finishing Google Sheets first.

limits: Visible text transfer only; spreadsheet formulas and styles are not imported.
Native Excel, Windows, Linux, accessibility, OS failure handling, and input latency remain unverified.
Native screenshots were inspected during the session; the persisted artifacts contain synthetic Markdown/text only.
A desktop-control app launch stalled for roughly 585 seconds; this is not an application latency measurement.
privacy: Private spreadsheet identifiers, account information, and browser accessibility trees are omitted.
